programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is a party in the air with an Italian flair. Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. Recipes include a succulent Roasted Chicken; a simple and earthy Seared Chicken Breast with Mushrooms; and finally a dish with a little kick - Paprika Drumsticks with Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. In this episode, Lidia shares a meal where wine plays a part of each delicious dish: Sausage Crostini: a toasted piece of bread topped with sweet Italian sausage and topped with taleggio cheese; Linguine with White Clam Sauce: a simple white wine clam sauce served with linguine pasta; Braised Beef Rolls: stuffed beef rolls oozing with the flavors of prosciutto, provolone and golden raisins served in a red wine tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italy is one big garden with a year round growing season. Vegetables are often the stars of the meal, and today Lidia will highlight the versatility of delicious bitter vegetables like broccoli rabe, radicchio and escarole.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fruit desserts have always been an Italian tradition; they are simple, delicious and the perfect way to showcase nature's bounty. In this episode, the Lidia highlights some of her fans' preferred seasonal sweets with: Strawberries with Balsamic Vinegar, a light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Fresh Fruit; juicy Nectarines and Blueberries in Prosecco and a Plum Crostata, a free form Italian tart with juicy plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their crepes either savory or sweet and this episode, Lidia shows two of her favorite crespelle dishes, along with some great chef tips. She will start by highlighting the thin pancakes that can be made into so many things; then she'll make a savory Italian favorite with them - Manicotti and for a sweet version, she will show the Chocolate and Walnut Crespelle that will satisfy any sweet tooth.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steak is a favorite in many American households, and this episode is a tribute to the nice juicy dish and showcase not only one of Lidia's preferred preparations but two other recipes that work well for a special steak house evening at home. Featured recipes include Seared Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Braised Escarole; Baked Potatoes with Pancetta and Oregano; and an Almond Cake with Chocolate Chips.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Braising is a preferred technique in Lidia's kitchen and today she prepares one rich braised meat dish, along with two braised vegetable choices for the home cook. Recipes include: Beef Braised in Barolo; a Braised Kale with Bacon; and finally Braised Cauliflower.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tomato Is not native to Italy, but it made a big impact on Italian cuisine when it arrived centuries ago. From canned to vine ripened, Lidia shares with you several of her favorite tomato dishes including: Stuffed Tomatoes: stuffed with rice, mozzarella and basil; Braised Pork Ribs with Rigatoni: Tender to the bone pork ribs and braising sauce with rigatoni; and Green Beans in Chunky Tomato Sauce: a perfect side of fresh green beans smothered in a fresh chunky tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics have always been favorites at the family table and in this episode, there is reason to celebrate. Today's recipes include the most iconic Italian American dish, Spaghetti and Meatballs; a Broccoli Rabe with Garlic; and a holiday must - Zeppole.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini sauteed with garlic, anchovies and capers; fried zucchini; orecchiette with clams and zucchini; sweet-and-sour zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's a world famous technique but made with milk, it is famous only in the Italian region of Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table all year long, and she loves to plan a dinner that showcases the best and freshest of seafood. The menu is diverse today, as she prepares Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, a fun and elegant dish that is served with grilled bread; Cucumber Salad, a refreshing salad dressed with sweet honey, tangy vinegar and crunchy celery; and finally Baked Striped Bass with Lemon Sauce - made with cheese flavored breadcrumbs and baked to golden perfection.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Soups are a part of any Italian celebration, and Americans love pairing them with a salad and sandwich. Today, Lidia will combine the best of both with a unique Italian style menu of soup, salad and bruschetta. The menu includes Spicy Italian Style Vegetable Soup, Bruschetta with Ndjua - a crunchy country bread topped with a spicy sausage and a simple and delicious Skillet Peppers and Potatoes.
programme.sub-title: Spiced Up Soup and Salad Night

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Simple recipes are a must for weeknight dinners, and Lidia always looks for those that that deliver a burst of flavor. In this episode, she will share some of her favorite quick weeknight dinner ideas. She starts with a Sausage Crostini, made of sweet Italian sausage topped with Taleggio cheese. She then prepares a Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce; an iconic creamy Italian American pasta dish and then Arugula Salad with Porcini Mushroom & Shavings of Cheese.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia says that the key to a great party is always the food, and in this episode she features some of her best party recipes from over the years. Bruschetta is always a great snack to pass around, and the combinations are endless. Her Fig & Prosciutto Bruschetta is a unique and delicious party item that she includes at almost any gathering. She'll also prepare a colorful Marinated Winter Squash that is a favorite at her home parties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, it's all about some of Italy's most popular staples. Lidia will share three of her all-time favorites including a Chicken Parmigiana Light - a version of the famous Chicken Parmigiana - made with a chicken thigh topped with fresh tomato and mozzarella and nestled in a bed of tomato sauce. Her Beef and Arugula Bruschetta is a perfect and quick starter to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today Lidia shares some new show-stopping dishes for the perfect family style brunch that include Crostata with Kale Butternut Squash and Ricotta - made of a flaky dough filled with a creamy colorful mix of ricotta, kale, butternut squash and golden raisins. Carrot and Orange Salad is the next item on the menu-a bright dish that adds color to any meal. Lidia's Potato and Egg Frico - a crispy Asiago cheese crust made with potatoes and eggs is always a winner at the brunch table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love a good picnic, and Lidia shares some of her favorite picnic foods from her childhood. The menu includes Herb Frittata Rollups, a must-have finger food rolled up with a layer of flavor packed pesto. Lidia's Pasta Salad with Tomato, Mozzarella and Green Beans is a hearty pasta salad that is perfect for any picnic. Her Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait is made with homemade ricotta, blueberry sauce, candied almonds and cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's menu, Lidia serves Chicken and Sausage Bites with Apple Cider Vinegar Sauce, made with rosemary, vinegar, and honey. Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Soups are a delicious and comforting way to warm up especially in the winter months. On the menu today is Spicy Italian Soup, Calabria's version of vegetable soup; The Perfect Simple Salad, a simple and light side that works for any kind of soup; and an easy-to-make Butternut Squash Soup, garnished with crispy crumbled bacon.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. First on the menu is Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, an elegant and luxurious way to serve mussels. Lidia loves peperoncino in almost any dish, especially when making Spicy Stuffed Clams. And finally, Lidia makes Chicken and Zucchini Salad with Horseradish Dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about rice, and Lidia teaches viewers how to master the technique of making risotto. She starts with an Italian classic, Risotto with Mushrooms; next is Red Onions Stuffed with Rice. No food should be wasted, and Lidia shows viewers how to use risotto leftovers by making Fried Risotto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite chocolate desserts and one deliciously creamy risotto recipe. First, she makes a Chocolate Hazelnut Bread Parfait, a special treat she had growing up. Lidia then makes a soft and creamy spoon dessert, Chocolate Zabaglione. Lastly, she prepares a rich and smooth Risotto with Artichokes, Sunchokes, and Mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and alioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

A donor is found, and Life Flight quickly gets the heart airborne on Christmas Eve, fighting a winter storm with no time to lose.

Skeptical and looking for the real scoop, Charlotte drives to see the real estate head honcho to question him. On the way, she gets into a terrible car accident and wakes up in the hospital only to realize that her body is in a coma, but her spirit is still very much awake.

programme.title: Lucky Christmas

The only catch is that she unknowingly has been paired up witha high powered fashion photographer who also happens to be her estranged ex. Will they be able to pull off the campaign or will the past sabotage the project before it begins? Stars Jessica Lowndes and Christopher Russell.

A letter from a young boy promising his tree is perfect sends her to a small town where she learns the young boy's dad isn't willing to part with his tree. While sparks fly, she'll be forced to confront what she's really been missing for Christmas. Stars Brooke D'Orsay, Marc Blucas.

programme.title: Return to Christmas Creek
programme.desc: After being rejected and told that the new idea for her holiday app lacked the spirit of Christmas, young dot com CEO Amelia Hayes decides to return home to the Inn she grew up at in Christmas Creek. She is just in time for the 40th anniversary of the Fly By Santa event that her Uncle Harry arranges. Harry is a charter pilot who flies over the town dressed as Santa each Christmas Eve to deliver presents to underserved children in neighboring towns.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Presenters Nicki Chapman and Jules Hudson meet a clog maker who carves shoes by hand and visit the Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum to hear about the regiment's involvement at Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Crooner Tony Christie visits Coalbrookdale, the place where ground-breaking techniques were developed that kick-started the industrial revolution; and pop royalty Jimmy Osmond gets to whizz round the historical race circuit at Donington.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Vocal coaches David and Carrie Grant swap singing for antiques; David visits Cambridge and the birthplace of football, while Carrie learns how Letchworth Garden City sparked a revolution in town design.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actors Susan Cookson and Suzannne Packer battle it out around the northwest of England; Susan discovers her inner haggler as Suzanne keeps the purse-string very tight as she bids to discover an item with some real age.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Gastronomes Tony Singh and Cyrus Todiwala visit the east coast of Scotland; Tony discovers why one Scottish city was home to many millionaires and Cyrus finds out why Anstruther was a pivotal fishing port in the 19th century.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top wheelchair Paralympians Tanni Grey-Thompson and Jade Jones look for antiques in the northeast of England; Tanni tries her hand at traditional glassmaking and Jade learns about the man who was a design champion of the region.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Journalists John Stapleton and Lynn Faulds Wood are joined by Thomas Plant and Margie Cooper; Lynn and Thomas are knee-deep in antiques while hunting for biscuit tins and Margie tries to convince John some rare lamps will make a profit.
programme.sub-title: John Stapleton and Lynn Faulds Wood

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams travel from Bletchley to an auction in London; they hear how Mrs. Beeton became the first domestic goddess and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were daily wear.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are on the hunt for antiques; an incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It's a Welsh road trip for Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw; some fake currency and a leg of mutton could cause problems for the pair of antiquers at a Somerset auction.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Kate and Paul travel across the West Country to scavenge for riches; Paul picks up items from Africa, America, and Staffordshire, while Kate gets a chance to blow the biggest horn.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Paul Laidlaw resorts to tank warfare to crush Kate Bliss's chances of profit; Kate finds out about a decisive naval confrontation while Paul heads to Southampton to discover how Britain's landscape has been mapped for generations.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss hope to capitalize on some risky buys; Paul believes a strange collection of medals will honor him with profits, but a pricey three-figure gamble purchase might not pay off for Kate.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw's final trip sees them through Kent; at an incredible auction in Bury St. Edmunds, the record profit is truly smashed, and when the gavel finally goes down one expert is left close to tears.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina and James are in the Scottish Borders with a 60s Jaguar; while James rummages in the dark with a torchlight, Christina examines some silver-plated cutlery.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton are in the cold and snowy Trossachs; James investigates some ancient treasures in a Glasgow graveyard and farmer's wife Christina learns why it was the Scots who transformed arable farming.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton start in Levenshulme, Manchester; James has the unusual problem of having too much cash, while Christina struggles with her limited funds, deciding to gamble them on a worn toy train.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton stop at the seaside town of Southport in Merseyside; Christina dibs her way to a purchase, while James risks a large sum by buying a set of partially-damaged Cantonese jardinières.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina and James are in the north east of England; while Christina sees worth in a Chinese silver bowl, James become interested in some Japanese porcelain teacups.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Arusha and Philip set off on their journey in a 1976 Triumph Stag; they take a trip to a ducking stool and the Museum of Royal Worcester.
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Phil Serrell plays a safe bet with a mahogany breakfast table, while Arusha "Roo" Irvine's all at sea, gambling on an antique pond yacht.
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell explore Yorkshire and Derbyshire; along the way they dig up coal mining musical history, Phil attempts to buy a horse and Roo picks up another piece of her favorite glassware.
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Roo Irvine and Phillip Serrell reach the outlets of Oxfordshire to the Stratford-upon-Avon auction; Phil is tempted by more tables and Roo resorts back to Georgian glass.
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: As Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell motor through the Cotswolds, Phil picks up a Victorian marmalade cutter, while Roo hopes a 16th-century bronze thimble will earn her a big profit.
programme.sub-title: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Charlie and James start out at the hop gardens and orchards of Kent and visit some of the county's finest antique shops; they also explore a Cold War submarine and discover how Pocahontas came to Kent.
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Charlie Ross and James Braxton travel to Sussex, Surrey and Hampshire; they also take in some Roman mosaics and discover the story of an Arts and Crafts masterpiece, before heading towards a Wokingham auction.
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: James and Charlie shop their way from Buckinghamshire to the Cotswolds, take a trip along the towpath of the Grand Union canal and find out about the incredible work of the code breakers of WWI, then head to an auction at Wotton-under-Edge.
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Charlie and James travel from Glastonbury to Frome by way of Exmoor, enjoy the wonderful West Country, visit a glorious gothic cathedral in Wells and discover the story, and taste, of Porlock Bay Oysters.
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Charlie, James and Nelly browse Somerset, Devon and Dorset; Charlie sticks to what he knows best: brown furniture.
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Margie Cooper visits a haunted antique shop; Paul Laidlaw hunts for militaria; Margie heads back to school in Barton-upon-Humber; Paul finds out about the origins of a chewy cake in Pontefract.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper kick things off in medieval York; hoping to repeat his £20,000 success, Paul has high hopes for a mysterious little Islamic pot; Margie's on the right track when she secures a deal on a Hornby trainset.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Paul Laidlaw hears about a WWI hero who continued to spend a fortune on collectibles while under fire; Margie Cooper heads to Whitby to find out about local sailors who went to sea in birds' nests.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Paul Laidlaw blows a massive horn while Margie Cooper goes bananas in a hothouse at Chatsworth House; Paul gets excited about bus conductors while Margie sweetens the deal with a very peculiar honey separator.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Margie Cooper goes into hiding; Paul Laidlaw gets on his bike; Margie's zebra goes up against Paul's gun.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Margie Cooper Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Raj Bisram and Catherine Southon start their Road Trip in Cambridge; Catherine falls for an 18th century silk tapestry and finds a delightful Victorian letter seal; Raj springs for a Francis Flint print and silver candelabras.
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram, Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Raj Bisram and Catherine Southon begin the day's trip in Norwich; a detour has Raj learn about a quaint market town's unlikely connection to Tutankhamun; Catherine hears about the region's ferocious warrior queen, the legendary Boudica.
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram, Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon finds a propelling pencil while Raj Bisram discovers 19th-century Italian hatpins; Catherine learns how melons have helped save millions of lives while Raj meets an endangered horse with significant history in the area.
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram, Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram head to the land of Bakewell Tarts and strong blue cheese; Catherine hopes 19th-century French Opera glasses will hit the right note, while Raj thinks tin-based Royal memorabilia will attract big bids.
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon hopes to be top dog with two porcelain Staffordshire poodles, while Raj Bisram has pinned his hopes on a spinning globe.
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Raj Bisram, Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Tim Medhurst and Christina Trevanion hit the puddles of a rainy south west; Christina travels on a historic rescue boat developed by Lawrence of Arabia while Tim aims for the sky to tell the story of unsung hero, early aviator Bertram Dickson.
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Timothy Medhurst Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina goes caving to uncover the little-known story of maturing cheddar cheese, before setting her sights on a very old egg; Tim gets a lesson in fire fighting; an emu, a kangaroo and a frog head to Exeter to go under the gavel.
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Timothy Medhurst Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: While Tim continues on his tobacco habit with a Boer War pipe, Christina offers a sermon from behind a Victorian lectern; touring the counties of Somerset and Devon, Tim scales a 500-foot cliff while Christina climbs a wardrobe.
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Timothy Medhurst Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion has an encounter with some wild ponies; Tim Medhurst buys a horse hoping to gallop after her; Christina is still ahead of the field.
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Timothy Medhurst Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Tim rings some very big bells while Christina calls in on a design museum and harks back to the utility furniture of the war and post-war eras; coin expert Tim finally buys a coin, and jewel magpie Christina stocks up on silver, diamonds and rubies.
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Timothy Medhurst Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine Southon and Paul Laidlaw squeeze into a very small classic car on their latest antiques-hunting adventure, starting out deep in the Sherwood Forest and maneuvering towards a tense auction in Market Harborough, Leicestershire.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine and Paul drive the byways of Worcestershire, Herefordshire, Powys and Gloucestershire; Paul finds some handcuffs while Catherine picks up some cute puppies, and they also take in a tour of one of Britain's finest little Norman churches.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Catherine and Paul shop their way from Wrexham to the Black Country; Paul picks up piggy bank but Catherine opts for something distinctly oriental; they also take a trip across the world's tallest aqueduct at Pontcysyllte.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Phil Serrell and Louise Gostelow scour the antique emporiums of Lincolnshire; Louise learns why bomber command pilots kept a knife in their boot and always carried a handkerchief, and Phil detours from the shops to meet a noisy man in Skegness.
programme.sub-title: Philip Serrell and Louise Gostelow, Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: A trip to Birmingham reveals there are more canals in Brum than in Venice; Paul takes a water taxi to uncover some goodies, including one grisly find that features gallows and a hanged man, and Catherine picks up a bargain Cartier-branded lighter.
programme.sub-title: Paul Laidlaw and Catherine Southon Day 5

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Experts Arusha "Roo" Irvine and James Braxton are braving the snow, traveling up the east coast from Northumberland to Edinburgh; Roo falls in love with one of her purchases and decides to wear it, while James finds something distinctly lavatorial.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Arusha Irvine Day 1

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Roo Irvine and James Braxton journey in their 1966 Mustang from Cumbria to Liverpool; Roo has a hankering for some curious military items and some of her favorite glassware, while James finds something that will help him attain the perfect physique.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Arusha Irvine Day 2

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Roo Irvine and James Braxton scour the shops of Liverpool and Manchester, hearing the David and Goliath story of women's football at the turn of the 20th century and, in Liverpool, uncovering the history of black seafarers.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Arusha Irvine Day 3

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Roo Irvine and James Braxton head to the Midlands on the lookout for some older items; Roo has to make her money go a long way and likes some carriage lamps, while James meets his namesake and haggles over a big box of fossils.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Arusha Irvine Day 4

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: James Braxton and Roo Irvine head back up the north west coast on the hunt for precious artifacts; Roo heads far out into Morecambe Bay to look for a local delicacy and James runs away to Blackpool to join the circus.
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Arusha Irvine Day 5

programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.
programme.sub-title: Fortuna Apartment, Topton House, & Frank's Interview / Fortuna & Topton

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.
programme.sub-title: New Boston Inn & Gloria's House / New Boston Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.
programme.sub-title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Steve gets promoted to Tech Manager. TAPS takes on a case that has a personal connection for Kristyn, one of their members. A little boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells whenever she's in the basement. The team discovers high EMF readings and concludes this could be the cause of the dizzy spells since there carbon monoxide leaks weren't detected.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Philadelphia's Eastern State Penitentiary to track down an apparition; the team investigates a haunted vacation home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Jason's hometown of Canandaigua, in upstate New York, to investigate two reported hauntings. A sinister force seems to be at work in the Leonard household. The homeowners have encountered various unsettling noises and events, including witnessing a full bodied apparition in their infant son's bedroom. Concern turned to panic when the homeowners discovered scratches on the back of their infant son's neck. TAPS arrives to uncover what is plaguing the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The season begins with the TAPS members traveling to Tombstone, Arizona to investigate the wild spirits of the old west. The group heads to the historic Birdcage Theatre, which in addition to housing performances, also served as a dancehall, saloon and casino after it opened in 1881.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A local homeowner in need of emergency assistance visits the TAPS office after a series of bizarre incidents threaten the tranquility of her home. Lynn Tedeschi has the sense that something mysterious, and possibly dangerous, is present in her home. Her children are terrified by toys which inexplicably turn on and off. Strange sounds move through the home as if echoing from the distant past. TAPS spends the night to determine if a haunted house is lurking in their own backyard.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum, the Northern State Hospital. Jason and Grant meet the skeptical caretaker, who wishes to dispel the stories of ghostly activity, but when the team is confronted with strange sounds and shocking evidence, they are left to determine whether or not there might be a little truth to the local tales. Then TAPS heads to Seattle's Underground Tunnels, a subterranean labyrinth below the city streets.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the abandoned Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum. Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Finders Keepers
programme.desc: Jaylin is a struggling single father trying to support his children and make ends meet. His friend Reg sets him up with a job as a delivery driver, but is still struggling. One day, he and Reg discover a box a pills. Jaylin wants to turn them in, but Reg convinces him to try and sell the pills, as it will help support his family. A gang of thugs begins to descend on them, as the pills are worth more than they originally thought.

programme.title: Get Da Big Bag
programme.desc: Good things come to those who get the bag, but it comes with a steep price.

programme.title: Domestic Warfare
